svg.title: Which runs the bot-health bot reports, and when
svg.desc: The end of a run of a listed bot on the default branch, and every night the latest run of every workflow, come to the bot. A run of a pull request or a fork is left alone. A run that passed closes the open issue of its workflow. A first failure that a second try can fix runs its failed jobs again, and its end comes back to the bot. Any other failure opens or updates the one issue of its workflow.
